gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend-deca: Loud, loose and a bit cheeky. Lexend Deca follows with an unshaded line and small capitals beside big lowercase, which lets Gugi's cut-open curves do the shouting.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-liter: Gugi hits hard and open. Liter sits underneath in plain sans form, with no stroke contrast and a lowercase that stands up proudly, so the heading's flair has steady ground to land on.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-matangi: Contemporary in feel, Gugi stretches its lowercase almost up to the capitals. Matangi follows with twine-like strokes and rounded letters left open, a hefty body that holds its ground under the display type.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-michroma: Distinctive from the first glance, Gugi pairs thread-plain strokes with open-cut terminals. And Michroma gives every letter a wide berth, so the pair's strongest quality is that spacious, wide-set look under a punchy heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-miriam-libre: Punchy up top, sturdy below. Gugi is best at flaunting its open-cut curves in a heading, while Miriam Libre, a sans-serif with wire-like weight and a generous s, does its best work quietly underneath.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Gugi brings bold, open-cut curves to the top. Mochiy Pop One, a sans-serif with a very large lowercase eye, matches that confidence with letters hung like clothespins, which is the strongest thing about this pairing.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Chunky, friendly and a little showy. Gugi belongs on the big, short lines where its capital-height lowercase can show off, while Mochiy Pop P One, a sans-serif, spaces its sizable letters with generous blank room between each.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-montserrat-underline: Bold meets brisk. Montserrat Underline brings oversized lowercase and round bowls with walls that never swell, and that steady line against Gugi's open-cut curves is the strongest thing this pair has.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mozilla-headline: Gugi opens with thin-free, thick-free strokes and big attitude. Mozilla Headline, a plain sans with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, should read easily over a long stretch, friendly and unfussy.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-nobile: Gugi shows up with no hairlines and open-cut curves. And Nobile, a plain sans with barely any gap between x-height and caps, would read smoothly across a long passage, its open mouths keeping the text easy to follow.
